result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom nav all render correctly. The only visually broken element is the discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' card, which reads '-0%' — a meaningless discount value. Horizontal clipping of the third carousel card ('Trattoria Piccol...') and the card cut off at the bottom viewport edge are expected scroll behaviors and not reported.

issues.description: The badge on the second restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' list displays '-0%', which is a nonsensical discount (zero percent off) and looks like broken placeholder or computed data.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0 or null, or populate it with a real promotion (e.g. '-15%'); add a guard so badges only render for discounts greater than zero.

issues.description: The '-0%' badge and the '€0 delivery' badge use the same white pill style, but the ramen card's '€0 delivery' benefit is also repeated in the metadata row below the title ('€0 delivery'), creating redundant information on the same card.
issues.suggestion: Remove the duplicated delivery-fee text from the metadata row when a delivery badge is already shown on the card image, or differentiate badge styling for promos vs. delivery info.
